🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 11/11 sectors positive on the week, but Technology and Energy remain sharply negative over one month and leadership is narrow: 4/5 top performers are Technology. Mixed one-week versus one-month sector performance and missing Risk/Cycle signals support the supplied NEUTRAL regime; style is mixed, with no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication leads on the week (+5.64%), with CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.54% | 1M: +46.00%) and TTWO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +17.89%). Materials (+4.87%) and Consumer Discretionary (+4.60%) follow; individual Materials stock returns were not supplied.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy (+0.55%), Utilities (+1.26%) and Technology (+1.48%) are the weakest sectors on the week, though all 11 sectors posted positive weekly returns. Technology’s one-month return is -14.80%; AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -26.61%) and CEG BELOW TREND (1W: -5.53% | 1M: -7.60%) illustrate weakness.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.54% | 1M: +46.00%), PLTR RECOVERY (1W: +12.03% | 1M: -12.52%), IBM RECOVERY (1W: +10.81% | 1M: -1.35%), QCOM RECOVERY (1W: +10.65% | 1M: -2.02%), ACN RECOVERY (1W: +10.64% | 1M: -0.64%). Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology); several top weekly movers remain below their one-month returns.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: EQIX BELOW TREND (1W: -3.26% | 1M: -1.77%), DLR BELOW TREND (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -7.01%), GS BELOW TREND (1W: -4.09% | 1M: -12.14%), AMAT BELOW TREND (1W: -4.98% | 1M: -22.47%), MDT CORRECTION (1W: -5.17% | 1M: +0.66%). Weakness is concentrated in Real Estate, Financials and Technology names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest weekly momentum includes CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.54% | 1M: +46.00%), PLTR RECOVERY (1W: +12.03% | 1M: -12.52%) and IBM RECOVERY (1W: +10.81% | 1M: -1.35%). MAJOR divergence is evident across major stocks, including NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +3.09% | 1M: -30.13%), GOOGL RECOVERY (1W: +0.84% | 1M: -15.37%) and JPM RECOVERY (1W: +0.86% | 1M: -4.82%); watch for trend breaks.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed, with a strong weekly bounce against a weak one-month backdrop: sector return +1.48% for the week and -14.80% for the month. AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +4.36%) and META ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.49% | 1M: +2.69%) contrast with MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -7.01%), NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +3.09% | 1M: -30.13%) and GOOGL RECOVERY (1W: +0.84% | 1M: -15.37%); stock-level positive counts were not provided.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials gained +2.17% for the week but slipped -0.44% over one month, signaling mixed momentum; sector-level stock breadth counts were not provided. V ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.79% | 1M: +7.43%) and MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.46% | 1M: +9.28%) contrast with JPM RECOVERY (1W: +0.86% | 1M: -4.82%) and GS BELOW TREND (1W: -4.09% | 1M: -12.14%).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare gained +3.63% for the week and +0.77% over one month, with a split between established strength and rebounds; stock-level positive counts were not provided. AMGN ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.66% | 1M: +5.53%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.05% | 1M: +8.21%) and JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +2.16%) show strength, while UNH RECOVERY (1W: +6.33% | 1M: -13.68%) remains below its monthly level.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Stay selective rather than making a strong regime call: broad weekly sector gains coexist with pronounced one-month weakness in Technology and major-stock divergences. Style is mixed / no clear leadership; monitor strength in CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.54% | 1M: +46.00%) and V ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.79% | 1M: +7.43%), while reducing exposure to persistent weakness such as AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -26.61%).

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Monitor whether PLTR RECOVERY (1W: +12.03% | 1M: -12.52%) and NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +3.09% | 1M: -30.13%) can extend their weekly rebounds and improve their monthly trends. BEARISH: Watch AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -26.61%) and AVGO BELOW TREND (1W: -9.90% | 1M: -11.22%) for further weakness.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Communication (+5.64%), Materials (+4.87%) and Consumer Discretionary (+4.60%) led weekly sector performance; overall breadth was 11/11 sectors positive. BEARISH: Technology (+1.48%) and Energy (+0.55%) lagged on the week and remain negative over one month, at -14.80% and -10.84%, respectively.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels were not supplied, so specific support and resistance levels cannot be stated reliably. Monitor whether NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +3.09% | 1M: -30.13%) and PLTR RECOVERY (1W: +12.03% | 1M: -12.52%) follow through, and whether AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -26.61%) stabilizes.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
PLTR (+55): Poland defense AI deal; RECOVERY (1W: +12.03% | 1M: -12.52%), confirming the near-term news tone but still negative over one month. UNH (+45): raised guidance; RECOVERY (1W: +6.33% | 1M: -13.68%), a short-term price confirmation with longer-term divergence. AMD (+50): AI growth catalysts; BELOW TREND (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -26.61%), a pronounced price divergence.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AMAT (-50): downgrade despite record results; BELOW TREND (1W: -4.98% | 1M: -22.47%), confirming weakness. AVGO (-40): reported Google chip-order cut; BELOW TREND (1W: -9.90% | 1M: -11.22%), confirming weakness. NKE (-45): tariff exposure concern; ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.71% | 1M: +0.46%), a price/sentiment divergence to monitor. GS (-35): bond-price-fixing trial settlement; BELOW TREND (1W: -4.09% | 1M: -12.14%), confirming weakness.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, with mixed style and no clear Growth-versus-Value leadership; breadth is 11/11 sectors positive, but top-five leadership is narrow (4/5 Technology). CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.54% | 1M: +46.00%) and V ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.79% | 1M: +7.43%) show relative strength. Major one-week/one-month divergences and negative Technology news/price signals, including AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -26.61%), warrant monitoring for trend breaks.
